title: Parking a change must park its sub-cards too
description:
When a change's status.json carries `parked: true`, the sync parks the parent card but leaves its child sub-cards sitting in the active lanes. Proven live 2026-09-07: parking 14 implemented/verify changes parked 14 parents and only 4 children — 37 open sub-cards had to be archived by hand through `hermes kanban archive`.

Work: make `syncChanges`/`parkCard` cascade to every child recorded in pm/command-center-links.json for that change, and cascade the un-park when the flag is cleared. Cascading must be idempotent — re-running parks nothing new. Tests: a parked change with three children parks all four cards; re-running reports parked=0; clearing the flag restores all four. Definition of done: `npm test` passes, branch pushed, draft PR opened. Do NOT deploy.
